title: Help answered with an insult
odia: ଉପକାର କଲି କୁକୁରକୁ କୁକୁର ମୁତିଲା ଉପରକୁ।
literal_meaning: I helped the dog; the dog urinated upwards at me.
explanation: The crude image expresses resentment when help is answered with harm or disrespect. It describes a feeling of betrayal, not a reason to assume everyone who needs help will be ungrateful.
meaning_odia: ଉପକାର କରିବା ପରେ ସମ୍ମାନ ଅପେକ୍ଷା ଅପମାନ ବା କ୍ଷତି ମିଳିଲେ ଯେଉଁ କ୍ଷୋଭ ହୁଏ, ଏହି କଟୁ ଚିତ୍ର ତାହାକୁ କହେ। ବକ୍ତା ନିଜ ଭରସା ଓ ମିଳିଥିବା ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟାର ଅମେଳରେ ଆଘାତ ପାଇଛନ୍ତି। ଏହା ସେହି ଅନୁଭବର ପ୍ରକାଶ, ସାହାଯ୍ୟ ଦରକାର କରୁଥିବା ସବୁ ଲୋକ ଅକୃତଜ୍ଞ ବୋଲି ଧରିନେବାର କାରଣ ନୁହେଁ।
usage_example: After covering a colleague’s shift, someone discovers that the colleague has blamed them for a mistake. (Original editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The source gives an ingratitude gloss. The bodily image is intentionally coarse and should not be presented as polite praise or animal-behaviour evidence.
